g.text: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M ◆ The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million ◆ Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law ◆ Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 ◆ Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots ◆ Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar ◆
